newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq July short interest down, was 1.5 bln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq July short interest down, was 1.5 bln shrs.

text.p: Short interest in 4,148 National Market securities was down as of mid-July, totalling nearly 1.504 billion shares vs 1.556 billion shares in 4,108 securities for the month of June, Nasdaq said Thursday.
The July short interest represents 2.77 days' average daily Nasdaq National Market share volume for the reporting period, compared with 2.91 days in June.
Short interest in 1,421 Nasdaq SmallCap securities was 51.2 million shares for July, compared with 52.0 million shares in 1,465 securities for June, Nasdaq said.
Short interest in all Nasdaq securities -- 5,569 issues -- totalled 1.555 billion shares for July, compared with 1.608 billion shares on 5,573 issues in June.
